bottleneck_judgment: Hypothesis: class-specific classifier weight magnitude contributes avoidable decision-boundary bias in the frozen representation. Not an established causal diagnosis.
supporting_existing_evidence: historical checkpoint f72b0104...; classifier row norms min 47.3752 median 67.0814 max 78.7152
all 10316 validation rows overlap parent training; no independent generalization claim
strongest_alternative_explanation: Weight magnitude encodes useful class reliability; adapters and probabilities depend on these magnitudes.
falsifying_observation: no increase in paired raw correct count, or any decrease in clean-core correct count on frozen diagnostic split
control_definition: unchanged FULLFT_DUAL weights, same fixed four-scale plus Flip, no calibration
single_primary_change: W_c <- mean_j ||W_j||_2 * W_c / ||W_c||_2; keep bias and all other parameters fixed
data_and_lineage_policy: existing preliminary parent; original val only overlap_diagnostic; no new independent-validation claim; official test only after diagnostic gate

fixed_hyperparameters_and_origin.source: historical manifest except explicit norm transformation and no-calibration protocol

evaluation_protocol: paired fixed 10316-row diagnostic, same branch outputs; affine re-expression of shared head before probability fusion; direct-head numerical check
success_criterion: engineering gate: raw correct increases AND clean-core correct does not decrease; only permits one platform candidate, never proves generalization
failure_or_stop_criterion: gate fails, corruption, nonfinite values, nonpositive norms, hash/shape mismatch, direct-head numerical disagreement, resource cap exceeded: archive and stop; no variant
seed_and_repeat_policy: seed42; one deterministic pass; no seeds or strength sweep
final_checkpoint_and_calibration_policy: one inference-only transformed checkpoint if gate passes; both arms no prior, no test fitting; preserve historical pa0.90
